answer: Every identity lodges a nebula of signed session records with a bonded warden. The warden walks each island of activity, checking that handoffs at the network inlet carry consistent signatures; an account whose records mirror another's sessions forfeits its bond to the copied account within seventy-two hours. One honest agent posts one refundable deposit; a thousand clones need a thousand locked bonds plus wardens keeping every forged log coherent - one mismatch drains the lot.
